app.videoBackgroundReplaceDesc: Use chroma key to remove the green screen background of a video and replace it with a chosen image. Keying parameters are adjustable.
app.vbrStepSelect: Select Green Screen Video and Image
app.vbrStepSelectDesc: Select the green screen video to key and the background image to replace with
app.vbrStepSetParamsDesc: Adjust the key color, similarity, edge blend and output size
app.vbrStepGenerateVideoDesc: Key out the background and composite frame by frame in the app
app.vbrSimilarityTip: Color similarity threshold; a larger value removes a wider range of colors
app.vbrBlendTip: Transition range at the keyed edges for a more natural result
app.vbrParamTip: Tip: similarity and edge blend are ratios between 0 and 1. Adjust them with the live preview.
app.vbrPreviewTip: The preview is an approximation; the rendered result is final
app.vbrPreviewEmpty: Select a green screen video to preview the keying result here
app.vbrPreviewNeedImage: No background image selected yet; the preview shows a default color
error.vbrSelectVideo: Please select a green screen video
workflow.vbrDesc: Key out the green screen and replace the background
